quote: We focus on boolean functions such as PARITY, MAJORITY, FIRST, and analyze their loss landscapes.
We analyzed models using the following metrics: ... Sharpness ... Parameter Norm ... LayerNorm Blowup ...
Our experiments assess loss landscapes, sharpness, and layer‑norm blowup, not generated text quality.
The paper does not employ any language model as a judge of generated outputs.
No human evaluations are performed in this work.
